title: Research sprint goal: Research: Python shell with a Rust core, one package, bundled Postgres
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Open on 2026-10-11 by pack coverage (none, weak or a false good): uv workspaces (members, one lock across them); maturin and PyO3 abi3 wheels and the linux amd64 and arm64 and macOS arm64 build matrix; clippy -D warnings and mypy --strict as CI gates beside ruff; pytest with testcontainers Postgres and criterion benchmarks; bundled PostgreSQL binaries shipped as a wheel and run by the package (initdb, pg_ctl start and stop, major upgrade by pg_dump and restore); SQLAlchemy 2 asyncio with asyncpg; Alembic expand-and-contract migrations; PostgreSQL advisory locks as single-writer invariants; pgcrypto; canonical pg_dump output that hashes byte-identically; nightly age-encrypted dumps and git bundles to S3-compatible storage with restore tested in CI; Typer CLIs that never prompt without a TTY and print JSON; FastAPI per-route capability dependencies; SSE streams with Last-Event-ID cursors outside MCP; server-side per-caller rate limits answering 429 with Retry-After; a single-process service composing roles by flag. Already answered: uv.lock and a uv-managed pinned CPython (python/uv-projects.md), publishing to and pinning from a GitLab PyPI registry (gitlab/package-registries.md), pgvector HNSW (agents/hybrid-retrieval.md).
